title: BUYER BEWARE!!
text: BUYER BEWARE!!. The baskets that are pictured is not what I received. I paid a large amount of money to have them shipped faster and was extremely unhappy. They have Asian symbols on both sides of each basket. Not that I mind Asian symbols, but this was for an American picnic style party, not Chinese New Year!
